gpt.rationale: The mostly subdued anxious/sad/surprised sequence fits an introverted girl well, with only minor overuse of broad surprise where a quieter stunned or wary look might suit better.

claude.rationale: Sprites consistently favor subtle, inward expressions (anxious, surprised, confused) befitting an introverted personality facing escalating dread, with only the final 'determined' choice slightly pushing toward overt resolve rather than quiet resolve.
